description.summary: client hints the window manager acts on

protocol.description:
This fork-only protocol (newm-river, a fork of river) passes the window manager what river learns from two client protocols it serves: xdg-system-bell-v1 rings and xdg-dialog-v1 modality. The window manager marks a window that rang while unfocused urgent, and opens a modal dialog floating over its parent, keeping the focus on the dialog while it is up. Since version 2 it also passes activation requests (xdg-activation-v1 and wlr-foreign-toplevel-management activate), which the window manager answers by focusing the window or marking it urgent.
The key words "must", "must not", "required", "shall", "shall not", "should", "should not", "recommended", "may", and "optional" in this document are to be interpreted as described in IETF RFC 2119.

interface.name: newm_river_hints_v1
interface.description: This global interface should only be advertised to the client if the river_window_manager_v1 global is also advertised. Events name river_window_v1 objects of the same client: a client that is not the window manager gets none.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The client will no longer use the newm_river_hints_v1 object.

event.name: bell

description.summary: a window rang the system bell

event.description: A client rang xdg_system_bell_v1 with a surface of this window (its toplevel or a subsurface or popup of it). A ring that names no surface, or a surface that is not part of a window, sends nothing.

event.name: modal
event.description: Sent in the manage sequence that introduces the window and whenever the window becomes or stops being a modal dialog (xdg_dialog_v1 set_modal, unset_modal, or the dialog object's destruction). The window's parent comes in river_window_v1.parent.

entry.name: token
entry.summary: xdg-activation-v1 with a token made from a fresh input serial

entry.name: urgent_only
entry.summary: xdg-activation-v1 with a token that names no seat or serial

event.name: activate

description.summary: a client asked to activate a window

event.description: A client asked to activate this window. For xdg-activation-v1 the compositor checks the token first: a token whose serial is older than the seat's last keyboard and pointer enter (it was made before the focus moved on) or that timed out sends nothing; a token with no seat or serial sends urgent_only. The window manager decides what to do with the window, for example focusing it for token and foreign_toplevel and marking it urgent for urgent_only, unless a window rule (on-xdg-activate) says otherwise.
